title: Situated Bayes - Feminist and Pluriversal Perspectives on Bayesian Knowledge
reasoning: The paper provides a theoretical and philosophical evaluation of Bayesian epistemology through the lenses of feminist and decolonial theories. It explicitly analyzes the historical and conceptual links between Bayesian probability and the 'omniscient knowledge of God' as well as 'Indigenous cosmologies,' and it discusses the ethical entanglement of knowledge production and 'response-ability.'
